thread:
maya: escalation — customer on Next.js 13 + Vercel build sees 401 only after bundling. raw curl to hosted API with same key works, local dev (unbundled) works. failed in prod after build. ticket #12345

maya: repro steps I gave the customer:
1) create next app
2) npm i @redwood/inference@1.4.2
3) import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference' in a server/action or client (they used client runtime)
4) next build -> deploy -> request returns 401 from /v1/generate

maya: logs show the outgoing request has no Authorization header (we use API Key). console network trace on the deployed site shows header stripped. locally the key is present.

alex: any chance the key is leaking into client (should not)? did they put process.env directly into client bundle?

maya: they said key is in server-side env and passed into page via getServerSideProps, but they upgraded to middleware/edge in prod. not sure if that changes bundling.

alex: can you paste their package.json + our package exports/field? sometimes bundlers rewrite main/module. also which bundler (next default webpack/webpack5) and Node/runtime?

maya: package.json snippet:
```json
{
  "name": "demo-next",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "dependencies": {
    "next": "13.4.10",
    "react": "18.2.0",
    "@redwood/inference": "1.4.2"
  }
}
```

maya: they import like `import { InferenceClient } from '@redwood/inference'` in a file that ends up bundled into the edge runtime.

jordan: hunch: exports map in 1.4.2 exposes only ESM `import` entry and `types`, but our published package missed a `require`/cjs build for consumers that get transformed by Next's webpack. result: bundler picks `import` path but tree-shakes our wrapper that sets default headers in the CJS path, so Authorization ends up missing in runtime. seen similar with other libs.

jordan: quick repro I used locally:
1) create simple next app\2) `npm i @redwood/inference@1.4.2`\3) `import { InferenceClient } from '@redwood/inference'` in an API route\4) `next build` + `next start`\5) curl the edge-like route -> 401\\n
jordan: `node -v` 18.16.0, next default webpack. bundlers will prefer `exports.".".import` if present. our package.json currently looks like:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  }
}
```

jordan: that missing `require` target is the issue for cjs consumers / bundlers that rewrite resolution.

alex: ah okay. short-term workaround for the customer: import the CJS build directly from `@redwood/inference/dist/index.cjs` (or pin to a patch we publish). also ask them to avoid bundling the key into client — keep it server-side.

oliver: I told the customer the workaround and asked them to test `import InferenceClient from '@redwood/inference/dist/index.cjs'`. they tried and auth header shows up now.

maya: thanks. can we patch the package so users don't have to special-case?

alex: yes — prepare a patch to publish 1.4.3 that updates package.json exports to include both import/require and types, e.g.:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  }
}
```

alex: also ensure `package.json` has `type": "module"` in the package root only if we ship mjs, and that dist contains both .mjs and .cjs artifacts. add a test in ci that does a `webpack` bundle and runs a tiny node script to verify Authorization header is attached.

support-bot: released @redwood/inference v1.4.3 -> patched exports map and added cjs artifact. changelog: "fix: exports map to include require entry to avoid bundler resolution issues causing auth header to be omitted in some runtimes"

maya: customer confirmed after upgrading to 1.4.3 the 401 is gone in prod. they used Vercel edge and verified Authorization present. :thumbsup:

alex: follow-ups: add a CI job (webpack & esbuild) to catch packaging regressions; update release notes with migration note for anyone pinned to 1.4.2.

jordan: also add a tiny README note: if you see missing auth headers after bundling, try the CJS path or upgrade to >=1.4.3.

oliver: I've closed ticket #12345 and noted root cause.

maya: closing thread. thanks team! :raised_hands:
